long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The clay is still here, and I was interrupted before I could keep any of it.
Whatever I take from the clay goes straight into my storage at home, where I can see it.
The telescope is the biggest thing on this island and it has been ignoring me, so I will ignore it back from closer up.
I will look at it properly while the light lasts, so I know what it is up to before dusk.

today.reason: I was interrupted at the clay bank, so I am going back to finish keeping the clay before the light goes and the evening starts.
